about: The Fathers ask whether Ethiopia's chariot will last until Christ's coming and are told it will be hidden. A prophecy follows of Rome and Ethiopia uniting, with Justin and Caleb meeting in Jerusalem, and of Caleb's two sons, Israel and Gabra Masqal, one given Zion and the other the hidden chariot. The Fathers confirm the vision and close the book's main narrative with a doxology.

sentences.i: And the chief bishops answered him and said: So then, you have told us about the curb for the enemy, that of Rome (?).
sentences.n: The Fathers speak to the narrator. ወ- 'and' opens the narrative; አውሥእዎ is the causative of 'to answer', with the suffix -ዎ 'him', and ወይቤልዎ 'and they said to him' (ይቤሉ, 3mp perfect of the defective verb ብህለ, + -ልዎ 'to him'). ሊቃነ is the plural construct of ሊቅ 'chief' (construct: 'chiefs-of'); ጵጳሳት is the plural of ጳጳስ 'bishop' (from Greek). ናሁ 'behold' + the emphatic -ኬ, 'behold then', resuming what was said before. መግረሬ is the word of ch. 113 (ወመግረሬ ፀር), where it is the bit made from the nails of the cross; so 'curb' (?), in construct with ፀር 'enemy' (the root is not secure). ዘሮሜ: ዘ- 'of' + Rome, 'that of Rome'; it may qualify the curb (ch. 113 gives the curb to the king of Rome) or the enemy ('the enemy of Rome'), and I follow the first (?).

sentences.i: And now, about the chariot of Ethiopia: will it remain behind until the coming of Christ, as you told us about Zion and about their faith? And likewise, will their chariot remain? And he said to them: No. It must be hidden.
sentences.n: Here is the question that frames both chapters: the Fathers ask whether Ethiopia's 'chariot' (ሰረገላ) will last until Christ's coming. In ch. 113 the chariot is Zion itself (the Ark) in the Ethiopian king's keeping; here the two are asked about side by side ('as you told us about Zion') and in the next chapter they are set against each other, so I do not fix more than 'chariot' (?). ወይእዜኒ 'and now' (-ኒ is an emphatic enclitic). ዘኢትዮጵያ: ዘ- 'of'. እመሂ / እመ ('or whether', 'if') introduce the indirect question. ደኃሪ 'behind, afterward'. ከመ here is 'as', comparing with what he said of Zion. ሀለዎ ይሰወር: ሀለወ with a suffix means 'it is necessary / fated for him (it)', followed by a subjunctive, 'it must be hidden'. ይሰወር is the imperfect of ሰወረ 'hide'; the sense wanted is passive, 'be hidden' (one would expect the ተ- stem ይትሰወር, so the form is a little irregular (?)). The answer አልቦ 'there is not' = 'no' (to remaining visible).

sentences.i: And again, hear me, that I may tell you this: for a little while they are bound to lift up their heads, the Jews, against the believers in Najran and in Armenia after these days. And this he does by the will of God, that he may make an end of them.
sentences.n: ስምዑኒ 'hear me' (2mp imperative + -ኒ 'me'; እንግርክሙ 'that I tell you' follows). ሀለዎሙ 'it is fated for them' again, with the subjunctive ያንሥኡ 'they raise'; ርእሶሙ 'their heads' is the idiom 'to lift the head' = to rebel, to grow bold. መሀይምናን 'believers' is a plural from the root of ሃይማኖት 'faith'. እምድኅረዝ 'after this' (-ዝ is a demonstrative, reduced from ዝ ). መዋዕል 'days' is the plural of ዕለት 'day'. በፈቃዲ is 'by the will of'; the ending -ዲ is irregular (ፈቃደ would be the construct), perhaps for 'his will' (?), but with እግዚኣብሔር following I take it as 'by the will of God'. ያኅልቆሙ is the causative of ኀልቀ 'to end', 'that he bring them to an end': 3ms verb + 'them' (a 3mp subject would be ያኅልቁሙ). Who 'he' is, in ይገብር and ያኅልቆሙ, is not said; God is the likeliest for the second (?). Najran is in southern Arabia (a historical place of Christian martyrdom under a Jewish king in the 6th century).

sentences.n: ይትለአኩ is the ተ- stem of ለአከ 'to send', here read as reciprocal, 'they send to one another' (the passive 'they are sent' is also possible (?)). ሊቀ ጳጳሳት 'chief-of bishops' is the title of the patriarch of Alexandria (the Ethiopian church's mother see). sentences.i: They will rise up in war to fight them, the Jews, the enemies of God. The king of Rome, Enya (?), and the king of Ethiopia, Phinehas, will destroy them, and lay waste their land, and build churches there, and slaughter the kings of the Jews, at the completion of this reckoning of twelve reckonings (?).
sentences.n: ይትነሥኡ is the ተ- stem of ነሥአ 'to take', 'rise up'. ፀብእ 'war'; ከመ ይጽብእዎሙ 'that they fight them'. ለፀረ እግዚኣብሔር አይሁድ: 'the enemy-of God, the Jews' (ለ- marks the object, doubled by the suffix -ሙ on the verb, as with ለጽዮን in earlier parts). The word order in the next phrase is hard: ንጉሠ ሮሜ ለኤንያ ወንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ ለፊንሐስ. I read ለ- before each name as the object/naming marker, 'king of Rome, Enya (?)' and 'king of Ethiopia, Phinehas'. Who these are I cannot say (?): they are not Justin and Caleb, who appear in the next unit. Phinehas is the biblical name (Numbers 25). አብያተ ክርስቲያናት 'houses-of Christians' = churches. ወየሐርድዎሙ: ሐረደ is 'to slaughter', the verb for killing animals, so the word is grim. ቀመር 'reckoning, computation, cycle' with ፲ወ፪ 'twelve' (ወ- 'and' between numerals, here ten-and-two) and the plural አቅማር: the phrase 'this reckoning, twelve reckonings' is obscure (?); I do not claim to know what period it measures.

sentences.i: Then the kingdom of the Jews will be brought to its end, and the kingdom of Christ will stand upright until the coming of the false messiah. As for those kings, Justin king of Rome and Caleb king of Ethiopia, the two of them will meet in Jerusalem. They will establish the offering of the chief of their bishops, and draw near, and unite in faith through love; they will give one another gifts and peace, and divide the land from its half, that of Jerusalem (?), as we said first at the beginning of this book. And again, concerning love: they will add the name of kingship. They will add one whom they have chosen in faith from the kings of Rome to the wood (?) that is named with David and Solomon, their fathers, so that he may be named king of Ethiopia. And the king of Rome likewise will take the name of king of Ethiopia and add it to the wood that is named with David and Solomon, their fathers, after the likeness of the four evangelists; and the fourth is one whom they chose, each in his own land (?). And after they have been united in this way and have set faith upright, they will take counsel not to let the Jews live, and each will leave his sons there (?).
sentences.n: This is a single very long unit (about a hundred words, over the usual ~45, but there is no ፤ or ። to cut at) because the source has no ፤ or ። inside it; I did not break it at the clause joints. ትትፌጸም is the passive of ፈጸመ 'to complete'; ትረትዕ 'will be straight' (the verb is ርትዐ, of ርትዕ 'right, orthodox', spelled here with ረ; intransitive here, transitive in አርትዑ below). እሙንቱሰ: 'those' + -ሰ 'as for'. ሊቀ ጳጳሳቲሆሙ is 'chief of their bishops' (singular ሊቀ with the suffix on ጳጳሳት), the patriarch, not 'chief bishops'. ሐሳዌ መሲሕ 'false messiah' = the Antichrist. Justin (ዮስጢኖስ) is the Roman emperor, Caleb (ካሌብ) is Kaleb of Aksum (6th century, the conqueror of Himyar); history is compressed here. ወይሠርዑ ቊርባነ: ሠርዐ 'to establish, ordain', ቊርባን 'offering, the Eucharist'; ወይቄርቡ 'they take communion / draw near' (from the same root as ቊርባን). ምድረ እመንፈቃ ለኢየሩሳሌም: 'the land from its half' (-ሃ 'her/its' picked up by ለኢየሩሳሌም, the same anticipatory pattern as ለጽዮን); so half of Jerusalem's land, or half of it for each (?). 'As we said at the beginning of this book' points back to the division of the world between Rome and Ethiopia in the early chapters. The crux of the passage is the ዕፃ 'wood' (?) that is named with David and Solomon; ዕፀ is 'tree, wood'. It seems to be a document or a wooden tablet or staff on which the royal names are written, but that is my reading, not a certain one. The four 'names' imitate the four evangelists. sentences.i: As for the king of Ethiopia, he will leave there his firstborn son, whose name is Israel, and will return to his own land with joy.
sentences.n: -ሰ after ኢትዮጵያ ('king of Ethiopia-as-for') marks contrast. ዘበኵሩ is 'who (is) his firstborn'. ዘስሙ 'whose name' (ዘ- 'who' + ስሙ 'his name'). Israel is the elder son of Caleb in this story; ህየ 'there' is the place of the meeting (unit 8). Unit 12 later speaks of a king of Najran, son of Caleb, who may be this Israel (?). ይገብእ 'returns'. ብሔሮ 'his land'; በፍሥሓ 'in joy'.

sentences.i: And he makes his younger son king, whose name is Gabra Masqal (Servant of the Cross); and he himself shuts himself in (?). And when they told the king of Najran, the son of Caleb, he comes to reign where Zion is. And Gabra Masqal also raises an army and goes with the chariot, and they meet at the narrows of the sea of Liba, and fight.
sentences.n: ያነግሥ is the causative of ነግሠ 'to reign': 'he makes (his son) king'. ዘይንእስ 'who is young'. ገብረ መስቀል = 'servant-of the Cross' (the name is Gabra Masqal, the Ethiopian king of Aksum). የዐጹ ርእሶ is uncertain (?): ዐጸወ 'to shut' with ርእሶ 'his head / himself' suggests 'shuts himself in' (monastic enclosure), and I follow that; but the ending -ጹ looks like a 3mp, and ዐጸወ would be ይዕጽው, so both the root and the person are doubtful. The sentence about Najran is compressed: I take 'the king of Najran, son of Caleb' to be Israel, the elder son, who hears that his father has handed the kingdom to his brother and comes to claim Zion; this is my reading, not stated outright (?). ከመ ይንግሥ ኀበ ጽዮን 'that he reign at Zion'. -ኒ on ገብረ መስቀልኒ 'also'. ሰራዊተ 'army, host' (collective noun, accusative). መጽብብ 'narrow place, strait' (construct መጽብበ); ባሕረ ሊባ 'sea-of Liba' (Libya? the Red Sea? uncertain, I leave the name). ይትቃተሉ 'they fight one another' (reciprocal stem).

sentences.i: And when they wept before him with tears, God looks upon the prayer of the two of them, and the prayer of their father, who is penitent (?), while he says, 'He too is an anchor (?)'. And he stood up to do the will of his father; and the young man too, his father loved him, and he prayed to God.
sentences.n: ኀቤሁ 'to him, before him'. ይኔጽር 'looks' (ነጸረ 'to look upon', here with favour); the prayer of their father is added as a second reason God hears. ንሱሕ is a hard word (?): from ነሰሐ (ንስሐ) 'to repent' (n-s-ḥ, with ሰ) would give 'penitent'; 'gentle' or 'humble' is also possible, and I have not checked Dillmann on it. The saying ውእቱኒ መልህቅ 'he also (is) an anchor' is obscure (?): መልህቅ is 'anchor', maybe as a figure for a firm support; I do not know who 'he' is. The next clause (ወቆመ 'and he stood') is read of the same son, 'to do his father's will'. -ኒ throughout is 'also, and'. አፍቀሮ 'loved him' (አፍቀረ + -ኦ 'him'): the object is the suffix and አቡሁ 'his father' is the subject (the accusative would be አባሁ), with ለውእቱኒ መንእስ 'as for him too, the young man' fronted and picked up by the suffix, as ለጽዮን elsewhere. So the father loves the son, and the son (ወጸለየ) prays.

sentences.i: And he said to Gabra Masqal: 'Choose for yourself between the chariot and Zion.' And he allowed him to take Zion, and to reign openly on the throne of his father.
sentences.n: Here a voice speaks: God, or the father (not stated; I do not choose). አፍተዎ is 3ms (አፍተወ + -ኦ 'him', spelled -ዎ; a 3mp 'they' would be አፍተውዎ, as ነገርዎ above is 3mp), so it is the same single 'he' as ወይቤሎ. ኅረይ is the imperative of ኀረየ 'to choose'. ለከ 'for you' (a dative of interest). Choosing 'from the chariot and from Zion' sets two things against each other: Zion (the Ark, ታቦት) and the 'chariot'. ሰረገላ again carries the open question from ch. 116. አፍተዎ is አፍተወ 'to allow, grant the wish of' (?). ጽዮንሃ: -ሃ is perhaps an emphatic enclitic (?). ገሃደ 'openly'. መንበረ 'throne-of'.

sentences.i: And to Israel also he allowed to choose the chariot, and to reign in secret and not be seen, and he sends him to all who have broken the commandment of God.
sentences.n: The two brothers are given opposite lots: Gabra Masqal Zion and open kingship, Israel the chariot and hidden kingship. 'Hidden' answers the earlier answer, 'it must be hidden' (ch. 116). ይኅረይ is a subjunctive after ከመ. ኢይትረአይ 'and not be seen' (passive-reflexive of ርእየ). ይፌንዎ 'he sends him' (the sender unclear, again (?)). እለ ተዐደዉ 'who transgressed' (እለ 'those who'), ትእዛዘ 'the commandment-of'. The sense of the sending may be a punitive mission against those who break God's law (?).

sentences.i: So God did for the king of Ethiopia: glory and majesty, and he grew great beyond all the kings of the earth, for the greatness of Zion, the ark of the law of God, heavenly Zion.
sentences.n: ከመዝ 'thus, so'. ሞገስ 'favour, grace, majesty'. ዐብየ is 'was/became great' (G perfect, intransitive; the causative would be አዕበየ), with the king as its subject. በእንተ ዕበያ ለጽዮን 'on account of her greatness, to Zion' (the pronoun -ያ is anticipatory; ለ- then names the owner). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'ark-of his law, God's': the ark of the covenant, the central theme of the book. ጽዮን ሰማያዊት 'heavenly Zion' sets the earthly Ark alongside the Zion of heaven (see Hebrews 12:22).

sentences.i: You have told us everything that happened, and joined it with the book of Demetrius of Rome, and prophesied to us what will be for the two cities, the pasture (?) of Christ: the churches (?) Anastasia, Arcadia and Marina, and Ethiopia, great cities of God, in which a pure sacrifice and offering is made at all times.
sentences.n: አኅበርከ 'you joined' (causative of ኀብረ 'to unite'). Demetrius of Rome is some earlier book (ደማቲዮስ), referred to as a known book; I cannot say more (?). ይከውንሂ 'what will be, also'. ለክልኤ አህጉር 'for two cities/lands' (ክልኤ 'two', አህጉር plural of ሀገር). መራዕወ is uncertain (?): from the root ርዕየ 'to pasture', so 'pasture of Christ'; the ending -ወ is unexplained (?). ንስታስያ ወአርቃድያ ወማሬና look like Greek-derived names (Anastasia, Arcadia, Marina); whether they name churches, lands or persons I cannot decide, and these are in the text transliterated. ዐበይት 'great (plural)'. ዘበውስቴቶን: ዘ- 'which' + በ- + ውስተ 'inside' + -ቶን '3fp them': 'in the inside of them' (the cities, feminine plural). መሥዋዕት 'sacrifice', ቊርባን 'offering/Eucharist'; ንጹሕ 'pure' recalls Malachi 1:11 ('a pure offering in every place').

sentences.i: the blessing of all the saints and martyrs, for ever and ever. Amen. Christ is our king, and in Christ is our life, for ever and ever. Amen and amen.
sentences.n: A closing doxology. በረከቶሙ 'their blessing' (the blessings of the saints, with a pronoun anticipating ለኵሎሙ ቅዱሳን 'of all saints'). ሰማዕት 'martyrs' (literally 'witnesses'). ለዓለመ ዓለም 'for age-of age' = for ever and ever (a doubled construct, as in the Greek). አሜን ወአሜን 'amen and amen'. The line of ፨ marks at the end close the last chapter of the main story; the colophon follows as a separate part.

glossary.ሥምረቶ: ሥምረት — his good pleasure (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር)
glossary.ሥጋሁ: ሥጋ — his body, flesh (+ -u) · 'the body of' before ለ- + a name (ሥጋሁ ለአማኑኤል 'the body of Emmanuel')
glossary.ርቱዕ: ርቱዕ — right, fitting (adjective, used as predicate) · predicate before a subjunctive, 'it is right that' (ርቱዕ ንስግድ 'it is right that we bow')
glossary.ሮምያ: ሮምያ — Rome (proper name, variant of ሮም)
glossary.ሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — chariot (noun) · also 'cart' for the vehicle that carries the Ark among the baggage (ውስተ ሰረገላ 'onto a cart')
glossary.ሰራዊተ: ሰራዊት — army, host (noun, collective; accusative here, 'an army'; construct 'army of')
glossary.ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
glossary.ስምዑኒ: ሰምዐ — hear me! (G 2mp imperative with suffix 1cs -ኒ)
glossary.ቀመር: ቀመር — reckoning, computation (noun; here a counted period) (?)
glossary.ቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — first (adj.) · adverbial 'first' after ኀበ (ኀበ ቀዳሚ ተወጠነ 'where it first began') · noun 'the first, the beginning' (በእንተ ቀዳሚ 'concerning the Beginning'; ቀዳሚ ትርጓሜሁ ክርስቶስ 'the beginning, its interpretation is Christ')
glossary.ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies') · adjective 'holy', plural, before or after a noun (ቅዱሳን ካህናት 'holy priests'; ለሐዋርያቲሁ ቅዱሳን 'to his holy apostles')
glossary.በህየ: ህየ — there, in that place (በ- + adverb)
glossary.በረከቶሙ: በረከት — their blessing (noun + -ሙ '3mp their', anticipating ለኵሎሙ ቅዱሳን)
glossary.በረድኤተ: ረድኤት — by the help of (በ- + noun, construct; ረድኤት help, aid)
glossary.በበሀገሮሙ: ሀገር — each in their own land (distributive በበ- 'each, every' + ሀገር 'land, city' + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በበውሉዶሙ: ወልድ — each with their sons (distributive በበ- + plural ውሉድ + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በተፍጻሜተ: ተፍጻሜት — at the completion of (በ- + noun, construct; from ፈጸመ 'complete')
glossary.በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God') · at, by (a place), 'at the narrows of' (በኀበ መጽብበ ባሕረ ሊባ)
glossary.በኅቡእ: ኅቡእ — hidden, secret (adjective as noun; በኅቡእ 'in secret')
glossary.በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
glossary.በአምሳለ: አምሳል — in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct አምሳለ)
glossary.በአንብዕ: እንብዕ — with tears (በ- + noun, plural አንብዕ)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በከዩ: በከየ — they wept (3mp perfect, G, b-k-y)
glossary.በደብተራት: ደብተራ — in tents (በ- + noun, plural ደብተራት)
glossary.በጽሐ: በጽሐ — he reached, arrived (3ms perfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ) · with ይእቲ as apparent subject, 'it reached' her bearing, 'her time came' (ወይእቲኒ በጽሐ ወሊዶታ), a 3ms form where 3fs በጽሐት is expected (?)
glossary.በፈቃዲ: ፈቃድ — by will (በ- + ፈቃድ 'will, desire'; the final -ዲ as written, perhaps for በፈቃዱ 'by his will') (?)
glossary.በፍኖት: ፍኖት — on the road, in the way (በ- + noun, fem.)
glossary.ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55 · construct 'sea of' (ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Sea of Erythra, the Red Sea')
glossary.ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
glossary.ብሔሮሙ: ብሔር — their country, lands (noun, accusative + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ተ: ውስተ — final syllable of ውስተ 'into', split off by a stray wordspace (ውስ ፡ ተ); not a separate word · also the final syllable of ነገሥተ 'kings of', split off by a stray wordspace (እምነገሥ ፡ ተ ፡ ሮም)
glossary.ተከሥተ: ከሠተ — it was opened, revealed (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ከሠተ)
glossary.ተዐደዉ: ተዐደወ — they transgressed (3mp perfect, tä-stem, ʿ-d-w; እለ ተዐደዉ 'those who transgressed')
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ትትፌጸም: ተፈጸመ — it will be fulfilled, completed (3fs imperfect, tä-stem passive of ፈጸመ; spelled with 4th-order ፌ, unexplained)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
glossary.ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him') · 'with him, in his hand' expressing possession or disposal (እስመ ኀቤሁ ክብር ወኀሳር 'for with him are glory and loss')
glossary.ኀብሩ: ኀብረ — they gathered, assembled (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-b-r) · they agreed, conspired (3mp perfect, here of a wicked agreement) · they united, were joined (of the two kings and their churches, before ወአርትዑ ሃይማኖተ)
glossary.ነበብከ: ነበበ — you have spoken, said (G 2ms perf.)
glossary.ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of') · accusative 'kings' as object (ያዐቢ ነገሥተ 'he makes kings great') · predicate 'as kings' (ኮኑ ነገሥተ 'they became kings', ?)
glossary.ነገርከነ: ነገረ — you told us (2ms perfect, G, + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ነገርዎ: ነገረ — they told him (3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ናግራን: ናግራን — Najran (proper name; city of southern Arabia)
glossary.ንሱሕ: ንሱሕ — penitent, repentant (adj.; from ነሰሐ 'repent'; 'gentle, humble' also possible) (?)
glossary.ንስቲተ: ንስቲት — a little, a short while (adverb, accusative)
glossary.ንስታስያ: ንስታስያ — Anastasia (?) (proper name, ንስታስያ for አናስታስያ; whether a church, land or person is not decided) (?)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us') · accusative object 'a king' (ወለደት ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ 'she bore a heavenly king')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ) · nominative, subject or apposition (ኀተምዋ አይሁድ 'the Jews sealed it'; ዕዉራነ ልብ አይሁድ 'the Jews, blind of heart')
glossary.አፍተዎ: አፍተወ — he allowed him (3ms perfect, causative of ፈተወ 'wish, desire' + -ኦ '3ms him', spelled -ዎ; a 3mp would be አፍተውዎ) (?)
glossary.ኢትዮጵያሰ: ኢትዮጵያ — Ethiopia, as for Ethiopia (proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for', contrastive)
glossary.ኢያሕይዉ: አሕየወ — that they not let live (ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative of ሐይወ/ሕይወ 'live')
glossary.ኢያረኵስ: አርኰሰ — he does not defile (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ረኵሰ 'be unclean')
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return') · in case, perhaps (እመ ይሁበከ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'perhaps God may give you offspring') · mother (እም, accusative, predicate: ወኮነተኪ እመ 'and she became a mother to you')
glossary.እመዐቱ: መዐት — from his wrath (እም- 'from' + noun 'wrath' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.እምሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — from/out of the chariot (እም- + noun)
glossary.እምነገሥ: ንጉሥ — from the kings (እም- + ነገሥ, the first part of ነገሥተ 'kings of' split by a stray wordspace from its final ተ: እምነገሥ ፡ ተ)
glossary.እምኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — than all of them (እም- comparative 'than' + ኵሎሙ)
glossary.እምድኅረዝ: ድኅረ — after this (እም- 'from' + ድኅረ 'after' + demonstrative -ዝ 'this', written as one word; እምድኅረ ዝ)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እንግርክሙ: ነገረ — that I tell you, let me tell you (1cs subjunctive, G + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
glossary.ካሌብ: ካሌብ — Caleb (proper name; king of Ethiopia)
glossary.ካዕበተ: ካዕበት — a second time, double (noun/adverb, accusative; from ካዕብ 'double'; ወወሰከ ካዕበተ 'he doubled', idiom uncertain) (?) · construct 'double of' before ሰብእ (ካዕበተ ሰብእ 'double that of men', or 'a second people') (?)
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ኵሎ: ኵሉ — all (accusative) · 'everything', used alone (እሰፍን ኵሎ 'I measure everything')
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55) · 'all those' as antecedent of the relative እለ (እምነ ኵሎሙ እለ ፈጠረ 'above (?) all those whom he created')
glossary.ወለእስራኤልኒ: እስራኤል — and to Israel also (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and as for him also (ወ- + ለ- + 3ms pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወሊቀ: ሊቅ — and chief of (ወ- + noun, construct state; ወሊቀ ዲያቆናት 'and chief of deacons')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወልዶ: ወልድ — his son (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted)
glossary.ወመዋዕሊሆሙኒ: ዕለት — and their days also (ወ- + plural መዋዕል + -ሆሙ '3mp their' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወማሬና: ማሬና — and Marina (?) (ወ- + proper name; whether a church, land or person is not decided) (?)
glossary.ወሞገሰ: ሞገስ — and majesty, favour, grace (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወራብዕሰ: ራብዕ — and the fourth, as for the fourth (ወ- + ordinal 'fourth' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወሰላመ: ሰላም — and peace (ወ- + noun; construct 'peace of')
glossary.ወሰማዕት: ሰማዕት — and martyrs, witnesses (ወ- + noun ሰማዕት, read as plural) (?)
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወቆመ: ቆመ — and he stood (ወ- + 3ms perfect, q-w-m)
glossary.ወበአሐቲ: አሐዱ — one (numeral; fem. አሐቲ; ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in')
glossary.ወበአርማንያ: አርማንያ — and in Armenia (ወ- + በ- + proper name)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበክርስቶስ: ክርስቶስ — and in Christ (ወ- + በ- + proper name)
glossary.ወተነበይከ: ተነበየ — and you prophesied (ወ- + 2ms perfect, tä-stem, n-b-y)
glossary.ወትረትዕ: ርትዐ — and it will be upright, right (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, r-t-ʿ; spelled ትረትዕ with ረ for the expected ርትዕ)
glossary.ወናግራን: ናግራን — and Najran (ወ- + proper name; city of southern Arabia)
glossary.ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአልቦሙ: አልቦ — and they have not (ወ- + negative existential 'there is not' + -omu)
glossary.ወአርቃድያ: አርቃድያ — and Arcadia (?) (ወ- + proper name; whether a church, land or person is not decided) (?)
glossary.ወአርትዑ: አርትዐ — and they made straight (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ርትዐ 'be straight')
glossary.ወአኅበርከ: አኅበረ — and you joined, united (ወ- + 2ms perfect, causative of ኀብረ)
glossary.ወአውሥኡ: አውሥአ — and they answered (ወ- + causative 3mp perf., w-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወአውሥእዎ: አውሥአ — and they answered him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, causative አ- stem, w-ś-ʾ; + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወአፍተዎ: አፍተወ — and he allowed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ፈተወ 'wish, desire' + -ኦ '3ms him', spelled -ዎ; same 'he' as ወይቤሎ) (?)
glossary.ወኢይትረአይ: ተርእየ — and that he not be seen (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms subjunctive, tä-stem passive of ርእየ 'see')
glossary.ወኢጻማ: ጻማ — and not toil (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + noun 'toil')
glossary.ወእመሂ: እመ — and whether, or whether (ወ- 'and' + conjunction እመ + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወእሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — and they, indeed (ወ- + 3mp pronoun + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወእምጽዮን: ጽዮን — and from Zion (ወ- + እም- + proper name)
glossary.ወከመዝኬ: ከመዝ — and thus indeed (ወ- + ከመዝ 'thus' + emphatic -ኬ)
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወካሌብ: ካሌብ — and Caleb (ወ- + proper name; king of Ethiopia)
glossary.ወካዕበ: ካዕበ — and again (ወ- + adverb) · 'and also, moreover' where it adds a further item (ወካዕበ ተቀብረ በህየ 'and he too was buried there', ch. 112)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወዐብየ: ዐብየ — and it grew, became great (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ʿ-b-y)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወየሐርድዎሙ: ሐርደ — and they slaughter them (ወ- + 3mp imperfect + -ዎሙ '3mp them'; ሐርደ 'slaughter, butcher' as the lemma; not checked against a lexicon) (?)
glossary.ወየሐንጹ: ሐነጸ — and they build (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-n-ṣ)
glossary.ወየሐውር: ሖረ — and he goes (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ወየኀድጉ: ኀደገ — and they leave (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ወያመዘብሩ: መዘበረ — and they ravage, plunder (ወ- + 3mp imperfect; the form ya-ʾa-mäzäbbəru is the regular ʾa-stem (causative) imperfect of the quadriliteral መዘበረ 'plunder', or the plain stem is meant) (?)
glossary.ወያኀብሩ: አኀበረ — and they join (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative of ኀብረ)
glossary.ወያኅልቅዎሙ: አኅለቀ — and they destroy them (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወያነግሥ: አንገሠ — and he makes king, enthrones (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ነገሠ)
glossary.ወያድኅነነ: አድኀነ — and he saves us (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem, d-ḫ-n, + -ነ '1cp us'; verb አድኀነ 'save')
glossary.ወይሠርዑ: ሠርዐ — and they establish, appoint (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ś-r-ʿ)
glossary.ወይረስየነ: ረሰየ — and may he make us (ወ- + 3ms jussive, G, r-s-y, + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወይቄርቡ: ቀረበ — and they draw near (ወ- + 3mp imperfect; spelled with 4th-order ቄ, unexplained); 'take communion' is also possible, cf. ቊርባን in the same clause (?)
glossary.ወይበጽዕ: በጽሐ (?) — and he offers, brings (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect; spelled ጽዕ, perhaps an error for ይበጽሕ 'he arrives' of በጽሐ; 'offers' is taken from the sense of the clause, lemma insecure) (?)
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይትለአኩ: ተለአከ — and they send to one another, exchange messengers (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem of ለአከ 'send', read as reciprocal; 'they are sent' or 'they serve' also possible) (?)
glossary.ወይትራከቡ: ተራከበ — and they meet one another (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of ረከበ)
glossary.ወይትቃተሉ: ተቃተለ — and they fight one another (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of ቀተለ 'kill')
glossary.ወይትነሥኡ: ተንሥአ — and they will rise (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, Gt)
glossary.ወይትካፈሉ: ተካፈለ — and they divide among themselves, share out (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem of ከፈለ 'divide')
glossary.ወይትወሀቡ: ተወሀበ — and they give to one another (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of ወሀበ 'give')
glossary.ወይነብር: ነበረ — and he dwells (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይንገሥ: ነገሠ — and that he reign (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, G)
glossary.ወይንግሥ: ነገሠ — and that he reign (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, G)
glossary.ወይከፍለነ: ከፈለ — and may he give us a share (ወ- + 3ms imperfect/jussive, G, k-f-l 'divide', + -ነ '1cp us'; the ለ is the last root letter; 'divide to us, give us a share of')
glossary.ወይወግኡ: ወግአ — and they strike, smite (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, w-g-ʾ)
glossary.ወይዌስቁ: ወሰከ (?) — and they increase (?) (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, read as G of ወሰከ 'add, increase', but the final radical is ቁ (q) not ከ (k) and the 4th-order ዌ is unexplained; root insecure) (?)
glossary.ወይዴምር: ደመረ — and he joins, gathers (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, d-m-r; the long ዴ- not explained; sense 'signals' a guess) (?) · here 'and he adds' (the name to the ዕፃ), the same verb as ይዴመሩ 'they add' in the same unit; 'add, join' is the likely sense
glossary.ወይገብእ: ገብአ — and it will return, pass (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወይፌንዎ: ፈነወ — and he sends him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, f-n-w, + -ኦ '3ms him', spelled -ዎ; 4th-order ፌ)
glossary.ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r) · here the first element of the name ገብረ መስቀል, 'and Servant-of' (ወ- + ገብረ, noun construct, not the verb)
glossary.ወጸለየ: ጸለየ — and he prayed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-l-y)
glossary.ወጸሎተ: ጸሎት — and prayer of (ወ- + noun, construct 'prayer of')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ዕፃ: ዕፃ — lot (noun); distinct from ዕፅ 'wood' · here read 'wood' (the board or staff on which the royal names are listed), probably for ዕፅ (?)
glossary.ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘስራሕ: ሥራሕ — of work (ዘ- + noun; printed ስራሕ with ሰ, the dictionary spelling being with ሠ, as in the published ወስራሕ; 'work, labour', sense taken from the parallel ጻማ; ዘ- as the genitive link after ጻማ) (?)
glossary.ዘበኵሩ: በኵር — who is his firstborn (ዘ- + noun በኵር 'firstborn' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘበውስቴቶን: ውስተ — in which (ዘ- relative + በ- 'in' + ውስቴ- from ውስተ + -ቶን '3fp them', agreeing with feminine plural አህጉር)
glossary.ዘኀረዩ: ኀረየ — whom they chose (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ዘእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — whom God (made king, etc.) (ዘ- 'the one whom' + noun as subject of the following verb; ዘእግዚኣብሔር አንገሠ 'whom God made king') · 'of God', ዘ- as genitive marker after a noun (ቤተ ክርስቲያን ዘእግዚኣብሔር 'the church of God') · 'of God' (ዘ- genitive 'of' + noun: ቃል ዘእግዚኣብሔር 'the Word of God') · 'of the Lord (is)', ዘ- marking the possessor before the thing possessed (ዘእግዚኣብሔር ሣህል 'the Lord's is mercy')
glossary.ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ዘየሐንጽ: ሐነጸ — who builds (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ḥ-n-ṣ)
glossary.ዘይሰመይ: ሰምየ — which is named (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect of ሰምየ 'name', read as passive; the plain stem used passively, cf. ተሰምየ) (?)
glossary.ዘይንእስ: ንእሰ — who is younger, small (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, n-ʾ-s)
glossary.ዘይከውንሂ: ኮነ — what will be also (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, k-w-n, + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ዘጸልኦ: ጸልአ — what he hated (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect + -o, ṣ-l-ʾ)
glossary.የህይጲ: የህይጲ (?) — they prosper, flourish (?) (3mp imperfect?; root and sense unknown, taken from the context only; no lemma proposed) (?)
glossary.የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.የኀድግ: ኀደገ — he leaves (3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.የዐጹ: ዐጸወ — he shuts (himself in) (?) (imperfect; ዐጸወ 'close, shut'; the ending -ጹ looks 3mp and ዐጸወ would give ይዕጽው, so person and root are both doubtful) (?)
glossary.ያኅልቅዎሙ: አኅለቀ — that they destroy them (3mp subjunctive, causative + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ያኅልቆሙ: አኅለቀ — that he destroy them, bring them to an end (3ms subjunctive, causative of ኀልቀ 'end' + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ያነሥእ: አንሥአ — he will raise up (3ms imperfect, causative Aʾ-stem)
glossary.ያንሥኡ: አንሥአ — they will raise up (3mp imperfect, causative, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ያአኵቶ: አአኰተ — he thanks, praises (3ms imperfect, derived stem, root ʾ-k-w-t, as in the published ወያአኵትዎ; with -ኦ 'him' anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር)
glossary.ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይሰመይ: ሰምየ — that he be named (3ms subjunctive of ሰምየ 'name', read as passive; the plain stem used passively, cf. ተሰምየ) (?)
glossary.ይሰወር: ሰወረ — that it be hidden (3ms imperfect/subjunctive of ሰወረ 'hide', read here as passive; the expected passive stem would be ይትሰወር, so the form is irregular) (?)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይትማከሩ: ተማከረ — they take counsel with one another (3mp imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of መከረ, m-k-r)
glossary.ይትራከቡ: ተራከበ — they meet one another (3mp imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of ረከበ 'find')
glossary.ይትወከፎ: ተወክፈ — he receives it (3ms imperfect, tä-stem + -ኦ 'him, it')
glossary.ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ይኅረይ: ኀረየ — that he choose (3ms subjunctive, G)
glossary.ይነሥእ: ነሥአ — he takes (3ms imperfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table) · he will sit, take the seat (ዝንቱ ይነብር ህየንቴሁ 'this one will sit in his place')
glossary.ይኔጽር: ነጽረ — he looks upon, regards (3ms imperfect, G, n-ṣ-r; spelled with 4th-order ኔ, unexplained)
glossary.ይንሣእ: ነሥአ — that he take (3ms subjunctive, G) · let him take (3ms jussive, ሢመቶሂ ይንሣእ ባዕድ 'let another take his office')
glossary.ይንግሥ: ነገሠ — that he reign (3ms subjunctive, G, n-g-ś)
glossary.ይዴመሩ: ደመረ — they add, join (3mp imperfect, G, d-m-r; spelled with 4th-order ዴ for the expected ድ, as in ወይዴምር)
glossary.ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ይጸግወነ: ጸገወ — may he grant us (3ms jussive, G, ṣ-g-w + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ይጽብእዎሙ: ፀብአ — that they fight them (3mp subjunctive, G, ṣ-b-ʾ, + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ደማቲዮስ: ደማቲዮስ — Demetrius (proper name; the 'book of Demetrius of Rome' is cited here as an earlier book)
glossary.ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ገብአ: ገብአ — he returned (3ms perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ጳጳሳቲሆሙ: ጳጳስ — their bishops (noun, plural ጳጳሳት + -ሆሙ '3mp their'); ሊቃነ ጳጳሳቲሆሙ 'the chief bishops of their bishops'
glossary.ጵጳሳት: ጳጳስ — bishops (noun; plural ጳጳሳት, here spelled ጵጳሳት; from Greek)
glossary.ጸንዖሙ: ጸንዐ — it pressed on them (3ms perfect, G, ṣ-n-ʿ 'be firm, strong', + -ሙ '3mp them') (?)
glossary.ጽዮንሃ: ጽዮን — Zion (proper name + -ሃ, here emphatic 'indeed'; or the 3fs suffix 'her' on the object) (?)
glossary.ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy') · nominative, collective 'an enemy' (ወይበልዕ ፀር እለ ኢታአምር 'an enemy you do not know will eat')
glossary.ፀብአ: ፀብእ — war, battle (noun, accusative) · also construct 'war of' (ፀብአ ሰይጣን 'the war of Satan') (?) · construct 'war of' (ፀብአ ዐማሌቅ 'the war of Amalek'; ፀብአ መሀይምናን 'the war of believers')
glossary.ፈድፋደ: ፈድፋደ — exceedingly, greatly (adverb) · 'especially' before a numeral (ፈድፋደ ፯ እምኔሆሙ 'especially seven of them') (?)
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing') · 'one' before ኅሊና (፩ ኅሊና 'one mind, of one mind'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu), the masculine, since ኅሊና takes masculine agreement in this part (ባዕደ ኅሊና, በኅሊና ሠናይ) · 'one' as antecedent of a relative (ይዴመሩ ፩ ዘኀረዩ 'they add one whom they chose'; ወራብዕሰ ፩ 'and the fourth, one'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu)
glossary.፬: ፬ — 4, spoken አርባዕቱ (ʾarbaʿtu) 'four'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'four' (ውስተ ፬ መሳምክቲሃ 'in her four supports'; spoken አርባዕ ʾarbaʿ before a feminine plural, አርባዕቱ with a masculine)
glossary.፻፲፮: ፻፲፮ — 116, spoken ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወስድስቱ (məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu wä-sədsətu) 'one hundred and sixteen'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፻፲፯: ፻፲፯ — 117, spoken ምእት ወዐሠርቱ ወሰብዐቱ (məʾət wä-ʿäśärtu wä-säbʿätu) 'one hundred and seventeen'; chapter number (numeral)
